diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the endpoint attribute reference in the provisioner environment, which already orders the wait resource after the cluster.

The explicit ng_depends_on list makes module.node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.workers wait for :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this, but its cluster_name input is already derived from the cluster name and establishes that dependency implicitly.

The explicit ng_depends_on list makes module.node_groups:resource.random_pet.node_groups wait for :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this, but its keepers.node_group_name already references var.cluster_name, which is derived from the cluster.

The Auto Scaling group launches worker instances but does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy; instances can start before their IAM role has the worker-node permissions required to join the cluster.

The Auto Scaling group launches worker instances but does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy; instances can start before the worker role's CNI permissions are attached.

The Auto Scaling group launches worker instances but does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly; instances can start before the worker role's ECR read permissions are attached.
The Auto Scaling group can launch worker instances before :resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth maps their IAM role, creating a race in which the nodes cannot authenticate to the cluster.
